proof_body:
by
  have hint : ∀ n : ℕ, IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => x ^ n / (1 + x)) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 := by
    intro n
    apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
    apply ContinuousOn.div (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
    intro x hx
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one] at hx
    have := hx.1
    positivity
  apply squeeze_zero (g := fun n : ℕ => 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1))
  · intro n
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg zero_le_one
    intro x hx
    have := hx.1
    positivity
  · intro n
    have e : ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, x ^ n = 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by
      rw [integral_pow]; simp
    rw [← e]
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on zero_le_one (hint n) (Continuous.intervalIntegrable (by fun_prop) _ _)
    intro x hx
    have h0 := hx.1
    apply div_le_self (by positivity)
    linarith
  · exact tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
target_source: Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, x ^ n / (1 + x)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
